long_biography.plain_text:
Alisher Usmanov’s route to industrial wealth began with a manufacturing venture during the late Soviet period. He then moved into finance and investment, using secondary-market acquisitions to assemble iron-ore and steel assets that became Metalloinvest. The group established metals and mining as the foundation for a wider investment career.

Usmanov later developed USM around telecommunications, technology and media, and made early investments in internet companies including Facebook. Fencing supplied a different thread: once a competitive athlete, he became a long-serving international administrator and funded programmes for the sport. His charitable foundation has also supported culture, education and scientific initiatives, extending the same institution-building approach beyond business.
